reuse.why: All providers share the new link guards and Fintegra reuses bank lookup and sync processing, but replacement duplicates unlink cleanup instead of extracting its reusable local operation.

duplication.why: The change duplicates the existing linking workflow, transaction download plumbing, Akahu balance calculation, and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Link orchestration and transaction downloading follow existing server layers, but the Fintegra account type belongs in its own provider module rather than simplefin.ts.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested linking and provider changes.

maintainability.why: Centralized guards make the rules manageable, but duplicated provider workflows and a validation-named helper that now mutates another account increase maintenance costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked reproduces unlinkAccount's local cleanup directly; extracting that operation would allow replacement and ordinary unlinking to share it without provider notification.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: the Fintegra starting-balance branch repeats Akahu's calculation while omitting its redundant currentBalance declaration, and its downloader reshapes existing authentication, POST, error handling, and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch, expanding a refusal guard into a mutating takeover operation; all six linking handlers still use the shared guards.
